items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: and Oscar and Nat had -- you know, it was like 2 parts that they were playing these things real fast, and so the drum and the bass, we were really working to try to keep that thing together.

ctx.x: Uh huh. Yeah, but I can't -- I don't know, that's where we were singing "Sunny Side of the Street" and I was trying to think of the name of the other thing where all of us sang in unison together, and he made some cute little vocal arrangements, you know. Now, I can't remember the name of the song, but it was a standard, too. One of them was a real good arrangement, but I don't recall what it was. But "Black Spider" would stand out in my mind

because it was so fast, you know, and Oscar and Nat had -- you know, it was like 2 parts that they were playing these things real fast, and so the drum and the bass, we were really working to try to keep that thing together. Now that's one record I would like to get, and it's called "Black Spider".
Well, it may still be around Decca someplace.
